title: Claude Code Adoption
description: How much Claude Code is used, and how much of what it proposes developers keep.

boundary.note: Covers only Claude API traffic — the admin Analytics feed and the OTLP telemetry plane. Usage served by {{providers}} is not included, so absence of adoption here is not proof of absence.

analytics.title: Per developer (admin Analytics)
analytics.description: Authoritative per-developer/day totals from the admin Analytics feed across {{developers}} developer(s).

telemetry.title: Per session (live telemetry)
telemetry.description: Real-time per-session activity from the OTLP plane across {{teams}} team(s); includes active time.

comparison.title: Official vs observed
comparison.description: Shared Claude Code activity metrics compared between the admin Analytics API and local OTLP telemetry.
comparison.empty: No shared-metric activity in this range.
comparison.boundaryNote: The official Analytics API does not cover 3P surfaces such as {{providers}}; telemetry-only usage is a review signal, not a misuse conclusion.

models.empty: No model usage in this range.

acceptance.empty: No tool decisions in this range.

trend.title: Daily trend
trend.description: Productivity over time for the selected lens.

teams.title: By team
teams.description: Per-team activity from the live telemetry plane (operator team labels).
teams.empty: No team-attributed telemetry in this range.
teams.emptyHint: Set OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES (e.g. team=…) on the Claude Code fleet to attribute by team.

developers.title: By developer
developers.description: Per-developer ROI from the admin Analytics feed.
developers.empty: No per-developer activity in this range.
developers.lockedHint: Viewing individual developer productivity requires the adoption:developer:read permission (deny-closed).

acceptance.title: No tool decisions observed yet
acceptance.description: Accepted and rejected tool decisions appear once the admin Analytics feed or OTLP telemetry reports them.

developer.title: No developer activity reported yet
developer.description: Per-developer rows appear once the Claude admin Analytics feed reports developer activity.

team.title: No team-attributed telemetry yet
team.description: Attribution needs both halves: the connector's resource_labels allowlist must name the team key — it is empty by default — and the fleet must send it.
